name: Gray failure (a liveness check misses it)
description: Four API servers. From second 20, instance 1 becomes 15 times slower, but its process is still alive. The load balancer only runs a liveness check, so it keeps thinking the instance is healthy and still sends it a quarter of the requests (round robin): its queue fills up, and requests time out or are rejected. Try the "outlier detection" version: the load balancer sees that instance fail several times in a row and stops sending to it for a while.
